full_details: You came down to Mistress Ansell's table. The fever was gone. The loaf was a finger short of the notch and still a penny. Firing is sixpence the week, and she did not take it at breakfast. The Shrew was at two at the Cross Keys, and you were not in it. Ranger's Comedy was at the Rose. You did not go to either. The letter stayed on the table. At the desk you tried four words of a spring note, struck them, and left the owl unwritten. The last line of the comedy was still open at night.
one_sentence: You were well, you stayed in, and you stopped a spring note.
title: Stayed in and stopped a spring note
